```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(goftest)
library(nortest)
```

###KS TEST###


Generamos una muestra

```{r}
n <- 50      
data <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1) 
```

Ordenamos los datos de menor a mayor
```{r}
data_sorted <- sort(data)
```


CDF teoricos

```{r}
theo_cdf <- function(x) { pnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1) }
```

ECDF empirico  (los datos)
```{r}
emp_cdf <- ecdf(faithful$eruptions)
```

Calculamos D

```{r}
ks_D <- numeric(n)
for (i in 1:n) {

d1 <- abs((i / n) - theo_cdf(data_sorted[i]))
d2 <- abs(((i - 1) / n) - theo_cdf(data_sorted[i]))
  
  ks_D[i] <- max(d1, d2)
}
```
  

Buscamos la distancia maxima

```{r}
estadistica_D <- max(ks_D)
```

Visualizacion

```{r}
plot(emp_cdf, main = "Kolmogorov-Smirnov ", 
     xlab = "x", ylab = "Probabilidad acumulada (Fn vs F)",
     xlim = c(-3, 3), verticals = TRUE, do.points = FALSE, lwd = 2)
```


# Overlay Theoretical CDF

```{r}
curve(theo_cdf, from = -3, to = 3, add = TRUE, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
segments(x0 = x_at_max, y0 = y_theo, 
         x1 = x_at_max, y1 = y_emp_plot, 
         col = "red", lwd = 3)

```

```{r}
ks.test(data, "pois", mean=0, sd=1)
```



Cragamos los datos faithful

```{r}
data(faithful)
datos<-faithful
```


Tenemos que comparar dos distribuciones empiricas

```{r}
ecdf_1=ecdf(datos$waiting)
ecdf_1
```

```{r}
ggplot(datos, aes(waiting)) + stat_ecdf(geom = "step")
```

```{r}
ecdf_2=ecdf(datos$eruptions)
ecdf_2
```

```{r}
ggplot(datos, aes(eruptions)) + stat_ecdf(geom = "step")
```


```{r}
ks.test(datos$eruptions, datos$waiting  , alternative = "two.sided")
```

Haremos una revisión visual de la función de densidad de los datos

```{r}
ggplot(datos, aes(x=waiting )) + geom_density(color="blue", fill="cyan")
```

Creamos datos aleatorios de una distribución

```{r}
simu<- rnorm(15, 1,4)
simu
```


```{r}
ks.test(simu, "pnorm")
```


#####Cramer Von misses


```{r}
cvm.test(simu)
```

```{r}
ad.test(simu)
```
